item.title: Traffic congestion builds on major expressways at midday
item.description: Traffic slowed on key expressways nationwide by noon, with PLUS, KLK and Johor-Singapore Causeway facing delays as smart lanes activated.

KUALA LUMPUR: The welfare of Royal Malaysia Police personnel must remain a priority, aligning with Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim’s concerns. item.title: 158 giant tortoises reintroduced to a Galapagos island
item.description: Over 150 giant tortoises reintroduced to Floreana Island in Galapagos after 100+ years, restoring key ecosystem roles.

item.title: DAP special congress part of party’s internal process, says Fahmi
item.description: Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil says DAP's upcoming special congress is an internal party process, with the MADANI Government focused on economic and institutional reforms.

item.title: Trump to remove Vietnam from restricted tech list: Hanoi
item.description: Trump to remove Vietnam from US tech export restrictions after meeting top leader To Lam; Vietnamese airlines place $37B Boeing orders

item.title: Iran prepares counterproposal as Trump weighs strikes
item.description: Iran may soon submit a nuclear counterproposal as Trump considers limited military strikes amid rising tensions and past deadly protests

item.title: Sabah flood victims rise to 3,768 across three districts
item.description: The number of flood evacuees in Sabah increased to 3,768 people by noon, with 18 relief centres active across three affected districts.

item.title: Trump to travel to China next month, with US tariffs in focus
item.description: Trump to visit China from March 31–April 2 for high-stakes trade talks with Xi Jinping after Supreme Court overturns many U.S. tariffs.

item.title: Police to question individuals in Azam Baki share ownership probe
item.description: Several individuals will be called to assist police investigations into alleged share ownership by MACC chief Azam Baki, following a Bloomberg report.

item.title: Malaysia to enforce Online Safety Act with hefty fines for platforms
item.description: Communications Ministry to use ONSA against online scams, with fines up to RM10 million for platforms failing to curb fraud and harmful content.
